claim: ORION shows that integrating sources before defining an identity strategy leads to costly corrections.
ARIADNA must assign canonical identifiers to people, projects, documents, and versions before indexes are generated.
The second lesson is to separate technical dates from validity.
The third lesson is to preserve provenance for every field, especially when several exports are combined.
Independent bilingual validation is also required.
Finally, historical errors may be used as distractors only when they are clearly marked and canonical evidence exists to resolve the conflict.
